items.claim: 股東會通過修訂重述的2014年激勵獎勵計畫（治理／薪酬事項，非資本配置數字），贊成逾93%
items.quote: over 93% of the shares present in person or by proxy
items.speaker: Melanie Cibik

items.claim: 股東獲得召集特別股東會之權利的章程修正案通過，贊成逾87%流通股（治理事項）
items.quote: Over 87% of the outstanding shares have been voted in favor
items.speaker: Melanie Cibik

items.claim: 主席表示股東提問將於會後回覆，會中無業務或財測討論
items.quote: We will answer questions submitted by you after the meeting.
items.speaker: Robert Mehrabian
